newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish stocks rise 0.76 percent, off highs.
newsitem.headline: Turkish stocks rise 0.76 percent, off highs.

text.p: Istanbul stocks saw modest gains in reaction to a two-week decline of 11 percent, despite downward pressures in late afternoon sparked by a court cancellation of a crucial privatisation effort, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 .XU100 closed at 1,850 on Tuesday, up 14 points, or 0.76 percent from Monday's close.
Trade volume jumped 60 percent to 20.2 trillion lira ($126 million) from Monday's 12.8 trillion lira ($78.6 million).
